<script>
    window.lowerCheckoutOverlayZIndex = function () {
      var cartDrawer = document.getElementById('CartDrawer');
      if (cartDrawer) cartDrawer.style.zIndex = '100000000';

      var stickyCart = document.getElementById('custom-sticky-cart');
      if (stickyCart) stickyCart.style.zIndex = '99999999';
    };

    window.restoreCheckoutOverlayZIndex = function () {
      var stickyCart = document.getElementById('custom-sticky-cart');
      if (stickyCart) stickyCart.style.removeProperty('z-index');
    };

    document.addEventListener('dialog:afterClose', function (event) {
      if (event.target && event.target.id === 'CartDrawer') {
        window.restoreCheckoutOverlayZIndex();
      }
    });

    window.checkoutClickNoLoader = function (button) {
      // High-Value Cart Restriction: prevent checkout attempts when blocked.
      // Uses the latest computed restriction state from theme JS.
      if (
        window.__hdtHighValueCartRestrictionShouldBlock &&
        typeof window.__hdtHighValueCartRestrictionShouldBlock === 'function' &&
        window.__hdtHighValueCartRestrictionShouldBlock()
      ) {
        return;
      }
      if (!button || typeof window.onCheckoutClick !== 'function') return;
      window.lowerCheckoutOverlayZIndex();
      window.onCheckoutClick(button);
      button.classList.remove('disabled');
      button.removeAttribute('disabled');
      button.querySelectorAll('.addloadr, #btn-loader').forEach(function (el) {
        el.style.display = 'none';
      });
      var btnText = button.querySelector('.btn-text');
      if (btnText) btnText.style.removeProperty('display');
    };

  <script>
    window.addEventListener('gokwikLoaded', function () {
      function isHighValueRestrictionBlocked() {
        if (
          window.__hdtHighValueCartRestrictionShouldBlock &&
          typeof window.__hdtHighValueCartRestrictionShouldBlock === 'function' &&
          window.__hdtHighValueCartRestrictionShouldBlock()
        ) {
          return true;
        }

        var proceedWrapper = document.getElementById('proceed_to_checkout_btn');
        return !!(
          proceedWrapper &&
          proceedWrapper.getAttribute('data-hvc-should-block') === 'true'
        );
      }

      function enableGokwikCheckoutButtons() {
        const shouldBlock = isHighValueRestrictionBlocked();

        document.querySelectorAll('.gokwik-checkout button').forEach(function (button) {
          if (shouldBlock) {
            button.disabled = true;
            button.classList.add('disabled');
            button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
          } else {
            button.disabled = false;
            button.classList.remove('disabled');
            button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
          }
        });

        var buyNowButton = document.getElementById('gokwik-buy-now');
        if (buyNowButton) {
          if (shouldBlock) {
            buyNowButton.disabled = true;
            buyNowButton.classList.add('disabled');
            buyNowButton.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
          } else {
            buyNowButton.disabled = false;
            buyNowButton.classList.remove('disabled');
            buyNowButton.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
          }
        }
      }

      function debounce(func, delay) {
        var timeoutId;
        return function () {
          var context = this;
          var args = arguments;
          clearTimeout(timeoutId);
          timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
            func.apply(context, args);
          }, delay);
        };
      }

      enableGokwikCheckoutButtons();

      // Cart section re-renders replace checkout markup with a fresh disabled button.
      // MutationObserver alone can miss the window when DOM keeps mutating (cart page qty
      // changes + drawer refresh + coupon widget), leaving the loader stuck in a loop.
      var enableAfterCartUpdate = debounce(enableGokwikCheckoutButtons, 450);
      document.addEventListener('cart:change', enableAfterCartUpdate);
      document.addEventListener('currency:update', enableAfterCartUpdate);
      document.addEventListener('cart:drawer:render', enableAfterCartUpdate);
      document.addEventListener('theme:loading:done', enableAfterCartUpdate);

      // Safety net if merchant script or repeated mutations never let the debounce settle.
      var stuckRecoveryTimer;
      function scheduleStuckRecovery() {
        clearTimeout(stuckRecoveryTimer);
        stuckRecoveryTimer = setTimeout(enableGokwikCheckoutButtons, 3000);
      }
      document.addEventListener('cart:change', scheduleStuckRecovery);

      var targetElement = document.querySelector('body');
      var observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
        var addToCartButton = document.querySelector("button[name='add']");
        var gokwikBuyNowButton = document.getElementById('gokwik-buy-now');
        if (addToCartButton && addToCartButton.disabled) {
          gokwikBuyNowButton?.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
        } else {
          gokwikBuyNowButton?.removeAttribute('disabled');
        }
        // Keep the buy-now CTA disabled if High-Value Cart Restriction blocks checkout.
        if (isHighValueRestrictionBlocked()) {
          gokwikBuyNowButton?.setAttribute('disabled', 'disabled');
        }
        debouncedMyTimer();
      });
      var debouncedMyTimer = debounce(function () {
        observer.disconnect();
        //Do Not Touch this function
        enableGokwikCheckoutButtons();
        observer.observe(targetElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      }, 700);
      observer.observe(targetElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    });
  </script>

  /* Loader CSS */
    #btn-loader{
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      background:#000000;
      border-radius:0px;
    }
  .cir-loader,
  .cir-loader:after {
    border-radius: 50%;
    width: 35px;
    height: 35px;
  }
  .cir-loader {
    margin: 6px auto;
    font-size: 10px;
    position: relative;
    text-indent: -9999em;
    border-top: 0.5em solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    border-right: 0.5em solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    border-bottom: 0.5em solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    border-left: 0.5em solid #FFFFFF;
    -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
    -ms-transform: translateZ(0);
    transform: translateZ(0);
    -webkit-animation: load8 1.1s infinite linear;
    animation: load8 1.1s infinite linear;
  }
  @-webkit-keyframes load8 {
    0% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg);
      transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }
  @keyframes load8 {
    0% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg);
      transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    100% {
      -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg);
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }

  <!-- BEGIN app snippet: custom-ab-script --><script async>
  (function () {

    // -----------------------------
    // CDP App Settings (Liquid)
    // -----------------------------
    const CDP_DOMAIN = "https:\/\/cdp-nd-api.honasa-production.net";
    const BRAND_ID = 1;
    const STOP_MAIN_THEME_REDIRECTION = false;

    // -----------------------------
    // Constants
    // -----------------------------
    const DEVICE_ID_KEY = "shopifyDeviceId";
    const AB_DATA_KEY = "shopifyAbExpData";
    const REDIRECTION_FLAG_KEY = "redirectionToShopifyPreviewTheme";
    const API_URL = `${CDP_DOMAIN}/v1/experiment/${BRAND_ID}/`;
    const LOG_API_URL = `${CDP_DOMAIN}/v1/log`;

    // -----------------------------
    // Error Logger
    // -----------------------------
    function logError(message) {
      try {
        console.error(message);
        const payload = JSON.stringify({
          brandId: BRAND_ID,
          source: "shopify-app",
          message: message
        });
        if (typeof fetch === "function") {
          fetch(LOG_API_URL, {
            method: "POST",
            body: payload,
            keepalive: true
          }).catch(function () {});
        } else if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.sendBeacon) {
          navigator.sendBeacon(LOG_API_URL, new Blob([payload], { type: "application/json" }));
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Error in logging error");
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Bot Check
    // -----------------------------
    try {
      const crawlerRegexAbScript = /googlebot|google-inspectiontool|google-extended|bingbot|adsbot-google|googleother|storebot-google|mediapartners-google|gptbot|chatgpt-user|oai-searchbot|claudebot|claude-user|claude-searchbot|anthropic-ai|perplexitybot|perplexity-user|facebookbot|meta-externalagent|duckduckbot|duckassistbot|applebot|applebot-extended|amazonbot|bytespider|ccbot|linkedinbot|baiduspider|yandexbot|sogou|exabot|ia_archiver|bot/i;
      function isCrawlerUserAgentAbScript() {
        const ua = (navigator.userAgent || '').toLowerCase();
        const isCrawler = crawlerRegexAbScript.test(ua);
        return isCrawler;
      }
      if(isCrawlerUserAgentAbScript()){
        return;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      logError("Error in checking bot")
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Get Shopify Theme Context
    // -----------------------------
    function getShopifyTheme() {
      try {
        const shopifyTheme = (window.Shopify && Shopify.theme);
        if (!shopifyTheme) {
          logError("Shopify theme object not found in window");
          return {};
        }
        return shopifyTheme;
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Error in getting Shopify theme context");
        return {};
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Storage Helper
    // -----------------------------
    function storage(storageType, operation, key, value) {
      try {
        return operation === "get" ? storageType.getItem(key) : storageType.setItem(key, value);
      } catch (e) {
        logError(`${storageType} unavailable`);
        return null;
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Cookie Helper
    // -----------------------------
    function setCookie(name, value, ttlMinutes) {
      try {
        const expires = new Date(Date.now() + ttlMinutes * 60 * 1000).toUTCString();
        document.cookie = `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; expires=${expires}; path=/; SameSite=Lax`;
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Failed to set cookie");
      }
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
      try {
        const match = document.cookie.match(
          new RegExp("(^|; )" + name.replace(/([.$?*|{}()[\]\\/+^])/g, "\\$1") + "=([^;]*)"),
        );
        return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[2]) : null;
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Failed to get cookie");
        return null;
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // UUID Generator
    // -----------------------------
    function generateUUID() {
      try {
        if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID) {
          return crypto.randomUUID();
        }
        if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.getRandomValues) {
          return ([1e7] + -1e3 + -4e3 + -8e3 + -1e11).replace(/[018]/g, function (c) {
            return (c ^ (crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0] & (15 >> (c / 4)))).toString(16);
          });
        }
        return "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(/[xy]/g, function (c) {
          const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
          const v = c === "x" ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
          return v.toString(16);
        });
      } catch (e) {
        logError("UUID generation failed");
        return null;
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // GA Event Sender
    // -----------------------------
    function sendGAEvent(variantId, experimentId, deviceId) {
      const eventData = {
        event: "shopifyAbEvent",
        variantId: variantId,
        experimentId: experimentId,
        deviceId: deviceId,
      };
      const interval = setInterval(function () {
        try {
          if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.dataLayer && Array.isArray(window.dataLayer)) {
            window.dataLayer.push(eventData);
            clearInterval(interval);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          logError("Error sending event to GA4");
        }
      }, 500);
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Redirect To Shopify Preview Theme
    // -----------------------------
    function redirectToPreviewTheme(themeId) {
      try {
        const alreadyRedirected = getCookie(REDIRECTION_FLAG_KEY);
        if (alreadyRedirected === "true") {
          return;
        }
        setCookie(REDIRECTION_FLAG_KEY, "true", 60);
        const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
        currentUrl.searchParams.set("preview_theme_id", themeId);
        currentUrl.searchParams.set("pb", "0");
        window.location.href = currentUrl.toString();
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Theme redirect failed");
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Hide Global Loader
    // -----------------------------
    function hideGlobalLoader() {
      var fallbackLoader = document.getElementById('custom-global-loader');
      if (fallbackLoader) {
        fallbackLoader.classList.add('loader-hidden');
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Check if present in main theme
    // -----------------------------
    function checkIfPresentInMainTheme(){
      const isShopifyPreviewTheme = getShopifyTheme().role !== "main";
      if (isShopifyPreviewTheme && !STOP_MAIN_THEME_REDIRECTION) {
        const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
        currentUrl.searchParams.set("preview_theme_id", "");
        currentUrl.searchParams.set("pb", "0");
        window.location.href = currentUrl.toString();
      } else {
        hideGlobalLoader();
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Set experiment data in Shopify object
    // -----------------------------
    function setExpDataInShopifyObj(experimentData){
      try {
        const keyValueBasedExperimentData = Array.isArray(experimentData) && 
        experimentData.filter(experiment => experiment.experimentType === 'key_value_based').reduce((acc, item) => {
          Object.assign(acc, item.variantData);
          return acc;
        }, {});
        window.Shopify.abExperimentData = keyValueBasedExperimentData || {};
      } catch (e) {
        logError("Failed to set experiment data in Shopify object");
      }
    }

    // -----------------------------
    // Main Function
    // -----------------------------
    async function initABExperiments() {
      try {
        let experimentData = null;
        const existingAbData = getCookie(AB_DATA_KEY);
        if (existingAbData) {
          try {
            experimentData = JSON.parse(existingAbData);
          } catch (e) {
            logError("Failed to parse cached AB data");
          }
        } else {
          let shopifyDeviceId = storage(localStorage, "get", DEVICE_ID_KEY);
          if (!shopifyDeviceId) {
            shopifyDeviceId = generateUUID();
            storage(localStorage, "set", DEVICE_ID_KEY, shopifyDeviceId);
          }
          const response = await fetch(API_URL + shopifyDeviceId);
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error("Experiment API failed with status " + response.status);
          }
          experimentData = await response.json();
          setCookie(AB_DATA_KEY, JSON.stringify(experimentData), 15);
        }
        setExpDataInShopifyObj(experimentData);
        if (Array.isArray(experimentData) && experimentData.length > 0) {
          const experimentId = experimentData.map(experiment => experiment.experimentId).join(',');
          const variantId = experimentData.map(experiment => experiment.variantId).join(',');
          const shopifyDeviceId = storage(localStorage, "get", DEVICE_ID_KEY);
          sendGAEvent(variantId, experimentId, shopifyDeviceId);
          const previewThemeExperimentData = experimentData.filter(experiment => experiment.experimentType === 'preview_theme_id_based');
          if(previewThemeExperimentData.length > 0) {
            const previewThemeId =  previewThemeExperimentData[0]?.variantData?.previewThemeId;
            if (previewThemeId && String(getShopifyTheme().id) !== String(previewThemeId)) {
              redirectToPreviewTheme(previewThemeId);
            } else {
              hideGlobalLoader();
            }
          } else {
            checkIfPresentInMainTheme();
          }
        } else {
          const shopifyDeviceId = storage(localStorage, "get", DEVICE_ID_KEY);
          sendGAEvent("NA", "NA", shopifyDeviceId);
          checkIfPresentInMainTheme();
        }
      } catch (error) {
        hideGlobalLoader();
        logError(`Shopify AB experiment initialization failed : ${error}`);
      }
    }

    initABExperiments();
  })();
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    document.querySelectorAll(".st-search-box").forEach(searchBox => {

        const input = searchBox.querySelector(".st-search-input");
        const clearBtn = searchBox.querySelector(".st-input-action-btn");

        if (!input || !clearBtn) return;

        function toggleClearButton() {
            clearBtn.style.display = input.value.trim() ? "block" : "";
        }

        toggleClearButton();

        input.addEventListener("input", toggleClearButton);

        clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            input.value = "";
            input.focus();

            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keyup", {
                key: "Backspace",
                bubbles: true
            }));
        });

    });

});
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const input = document.getElementById("st-search-mobile");
    const clearBtn = document.querySelector(".st-input-action-btn");

    if (!input || !clearBtn) return;

    function toggleClearButton() {
        if (input.value.trim()) {
            clearBtn.style.display = "block";
        } else {
            clearBtn.style.display = "";
        }
    }

    toggleClearButton();

    input.addEventListener("input", toggleClearButton);

    clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        input.value = "";
        input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
        input.focus();
    });
});
document.addEventListener("stSearchResultsEvent", function (e) {
    if (e.detail.source === "searchPage") {
        window.scrollTo({
            top: 0,
            behavior: "smooth"
        });
    }
});
</script>

    document.querySelectorAll(".st-search-box").forEach(searchBox => {

        const input = searchBox.querySelector(".st-search-input");
        const clearBtn = searchBox.querySelector(".st-input-action-btn");

        if (!input || !clearBtn) return;

        function toggleClearButton() {
            clearBtn.style.display = input.value.trim() ? "block" : "";
        }

        toggleClearButton();

        input.addEventListener("input", toggleClearButton);

        clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
            input.value = "";
            input.focus();

            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
            input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keyup", {
                key: "Backspace",
                bubbles: true
            }));
        });

    });

  (function () {
    function setSubAccordionHeight(menu) {
      var content = menu.querySelector('.hdt-collapse-content');
      if (!content || window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
      content.style.height = menu.classList.contains('open') ? 'auto' : '0';
    }

    function bindSubAccordions(root) {
      root.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-menu .hdt-footer-sub-accordion__header').forEach(function (header) {
        if (header.dataset.footerSubAccordionBound === 'true') return;
        header.dataset.footerSubAccordionBound = 'true';
        header.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
          if (window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
          event.stopPropagation();
          var menu = this.closest('.hdt-footer-menu');
          if (!menu) return;
          menu.classList.toggle('open');
          setSubAccordionHeight(menu);
        });
      });
    }

    function initSubAccordions(root) {
      root.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
        if (menu.querySelector('.hdt-footer-first-menu-links')) return;
        setSubAccordionHeight(menu);
      });
    }

    function resetSubAccordions(accordion) {
      if (!accordion || window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
      accordion.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
        if (menu.querySelector('.hdt-footer-first-menu-links')) return;
        menu.classList.remove('open');
        setSubAccordionHeight(menu);
      });
    }

    function closeMobileFooterAccordion(accordion) {
      if (!accordion) return;
      resetSubAccordions(accordion);
      accordion.classList.remove('is-open');
      var trigger = accordion.querySelector('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion__trigger');
      if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }

    function bindMobileFooterAccordion() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion').forEach(function (accordion) {
        var trigger = accordion.querySelector('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion__trigger');
        var closeBtn = accordion.querySelector('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion__panel-heading');

        if (trigger && trigger.dataset.footerMainAccordionBound !== 'true') {
          trigger.dataset.footerMainAccordionBound = 'true';
          trigger.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
            resetSubAccordions(accordion);
            accordion.classList.add('is-open');
            this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
            initSubAccordions(accordion);
            bindSubAccordions(accordion);
          });
        }

        if (closeBtn && closeBtn.dataset.footerMainAccordionBound !== 'true') {
          closeBtn.dataset.footerMainAccordionBound = 'true';
          closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (window.innerWidth >= 768) return;
            closeMobileFooterAccordion(accordion);
          });
        }
      });
    }

    function initFooter() {
      bindMobileFooterAccordion();
      bindSubAccordions(document);
      if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion').forEach(function (accordion) {
          resetSubAccordions(accordion);
        });
      }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initFooter);
    } else {
      initFooter();
    }

    window.addEventListener('metaFooterMounted', initFooter);

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
        document.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-menu .hdt-collapse-content').forEach(function (content) {
          content.style.height = '';
        });
      } else {
        document.querySelectorAll('.hdt-footer-mobile-accordion.is-open .hdt-footer-menu').forEach(function (menu) {
          if (!menu.querySelector('.hdt-footer-first-menu-links')) {
            setSubAccordionHeight(menu);
          }
        });
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

  </svg><script>
  (() => {
    if (window.__hdtPriceSummarySheetInit) return;
    window.__hdtPriceSummarySheetInit = true;

    const SHEET_ID = 'cart-drawer-price-summary-sheet';
    const OVERLAY_ID = 'cart-drawer-price-summary-overlay';
    const OPEN_CLASS = 'is-open';

    function getSheet() {
      return document.getElementById(SHEET_ID);
    }

    function getOverlay() {
      return document.getElementById(OVERLAY_ID);
    }

    function getCartDrawer() {
      return document.getElementById('CartDrawer');
    }

    function patchCartDrawerOutsideClick() {
      const drawer = getCartDrawer();
      if (!drawer || drawer.__priceSummaryPatched) return;
      drawer.__priceSummaryPatched = true;
      const originalHide = drawer.hideForOutsideClickTarget
        ? drawer.hideForOutsideClickTarget.bind(drawer)
        : function (target) {
            return !drawer.contains(target);
          };
      drawer.hideForOutsideClickTarget = function (target) {
        const sheet = getSheet();
        const overlay = getOverlay();
        if (sheet && !sheet.hidden && target && sheet.contains(target)) return false;
        if (overlay && !overlay.hidden && target === overlay) return false;
        return originalHide(target);
      };
      drawer.allowOutsideClickForTarget = function (target) {
        const sheet = getSheet();
        const overlay = getOverlay();
        if (sheet && !sheet.hidden && target && sheet.contains(target)) return true;
        if (overlay && !overlay.hidden && target === overlay) return true;
        return false;
      };
    }

    function ensureSheetLayer() {
      // If multiple sheets exist (e.g. cart re-render duplicated the template), prefer the body-level one.
      const allSheets = document.querySelectorAll('#' + SHEET_ID);
      if (allSheets.length > 1) {
        let canonical = null;
        allSheets.forEach((node) => {
          if (!canonical && node.parentNode === document.body) canonical = node;
        });
        allSheets.forEach((node) => {
          if (node !== canonical) node.remove();
        });
      }
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (!sheet) return null;
      if (sheet.parentNode !== document.body) {
        document.body.appendChild(sheet);
      }
      if (!sheet.dataset.handlersBound) {
        sheet.dataset.handlersBound = 'true';
        sheet.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          const closeTrigger = event.target.closest('[data-close-price-summary-sheet]');
          if (closeTrigger) {
            event.preventDefault();
            closeSheet();
          }
        });
        ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'touchstart'].forEach((evt) => {
          sheet.addEventListener(evt, (e) => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
        });
      }
      return sheet;
    }

    function ensureOverlayLayer() {
      let overlay = getOverlay();
      if (!overlay) {
        overlay = document.createElement('div');
        overlay.id = OVERLAY_ID;
        overlay.className = 'hdt-price-summary-overlay';
        overlay.hidden = true;
        overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          closeSheet();
        });
        ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'touchstart'].forEach((evt) => {
          overlay.addEventListener(evt, (e) => e.stopPropagation(), { passive: true });
        });
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
      } else if (overlay.parentNode !== document.body) {
        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
      }
      return overlay;
    }

    function syncSummaryCard() {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (!sheet) return;
      const source = document.getElementById('cart-drawer-price-summary');
      const body = sheet.querySelector('[data-price-summary-sheet-body]');
      if (!source || !body) return;
      const clone = source.cloneNode(true);
      clone.removeAttribute('id');
      clone.classList.add('hdt-price-summary-sheet__summary');
      body.replaceChildren(clone);
    }

    function setSheetBottomInset() {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (!sheet) return;
      const checkoutBar = document.querySelector('#CartDrawer .hdt-mini-cart__checkout-bar');
      if (!checkoutBar) {
        sheet.style.removeProperty('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset');
        return;
      }
      const rect = checkoutBar.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewportH = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
      const gap = 8;
      const bottomInset = Math.max(0, Math.round(viewportH - rect.top + gap));
      sheet.style.setProperty('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset', bottomInset + 'px');
    }

    function openSheet() {
      patchCartDrawerOutsideClick();
      const sheet = ensureSheetLayer();
      if (!sheet) return;
      const overlay = ensureOverlayLayer();
      setSheetBottomInset();
      syncOverlayInset(sheet, overlay);
      syncSummaryCard();
      sheet.hidden = false;
      overlay.hidden = false;
      sheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        sheet.classList.add(OPEN_CLASS);
        overlay.classList.add(OPEN_CLASS);
      });
    }

    function closeSheet() {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      const overlay = getOverlay();
      if (sheet && !sheet.hidden) {
        sheet.classList.remove(OPEN_CLASS);
        sheet.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (sheet.classList.contains(OPEN_CLASS)) return;
          sheet.hidden = true;
        }, 260);
      }
      if (overlay && !overlay.hidden) {
        overlay.classList.remove(OPEN_CLASS);
        window.setTimeout(() => {
          if (overlay.classList.contains(OPEN_CLASS)) return;
          overlay.hidden = true;
        }, 260);
      }
    }

    function syncOverlayInset(sheet, overlay) {
      const offset = sheet.style.getPropertyValue('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset') || '84px';
      overlay.style.setProperty('--hdt-price-summary-bottom-offset', offset);
    }

    function isDesktopViewport() {
      return window.matchMedia('(min-width: 768px)').matches;
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const openButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-price-summary-sheet]');
      if (openButton) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (isDesktopViewport()) return;
        openSheet();
        return;
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && sheet && !sheet.hidden) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        closeSheet();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('cart:drawer:render', closeSheet);
    document.addEventListener('cart:change', () => {
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (sheet && !sheet.hidden) syncSummaryCard();
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      if (isDesktopViewport()) {
        closeSheet();
        return;
      }
      const sheet = getSheet();
      if (sheet && !sheet.hidden) {
        setSheetBottomInset();
        const overlay = getOverlay();
        if (overlay) syncOverlayInset(sheet, overlay);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
    (() => {
      if (window.__hdtCapiCaptureInit) return;
      window.__hdtCapiCaptureInit = true;
  
      const getCookieValue = (name) =>
        document.cookie
          .split('; ')
          .find((row) => row.startsWith(`${name}=`))
          ?.split('=')[1] || null;
  
      const captureCapiData = async (cart) => {
        try {
          const fbp = getCookieValue('_fbp');
          const fbc = getCookieValue('_fbc');
  
          let cartId = cart?.token;
  
          if (!cartId) {
            const cartResponse = await fetch('/cart.js');
            const cartData = await cartResponse.json();
            cartId = cartData?.token;
          }
  
          if (!cartId) return;
  
          const controller = new AbortController();
          const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4000);
  
          fetch('https://api-v1.mamaearth.in/v1/external/capture-capi-data', {
            method: 'POST',
            keepalive: true,
            signal: controller.signal,
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              cartId,
              fbc,
              fbp,
            }),
          })
            .then((response) => {
              clearTimeout(timeoutId);
              if (!response.ok) {
                console.error('CAPI capture failed:', response.status, response.statusText);
              }
            })
            .catch((err) => {
              clearTimeout(timeoutId);
              console.error('CAPI capture failed:', err);
            });
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error capturing CAPI data:', error);
        }
      };
  
      document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        if (!event.target.closest('#proceed_to_checkout_btn')) return;
  
        const cartVariableElement = document.getElementById('cartvariable');
        const cartText = cartVariableElement?.textContent;
  
        if (!cartText) {
          captureCapiData(null);
          return;
        }
  
        try {
          captureCapiData(JSON.parse(cartText));
        } catch (e) {
          captureCapiData(null);
          console.error('Failed to parse cart JSON:', e);
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>

  /* Compact = only product image circle. Expanded = full pill. */

  .custom-sticky-cart--expanded.custom-sticky-cart--reveal .custom-sticky-cart__text {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--expanded .custom-sticky-cart__arrow {
    max-width: 38px;
    min-width: 38px;
    width: 38px;
    opacity: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: max-width 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.2s ease;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--expanded.custom-sticky-cart--reveal .custom-sticky-cart__arrow {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--compact {
    width: 48px !important;
    max-width: 48px !important;
    height: 48px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--expanded {
    overflow: visible !important;
    transition: max-width 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), padding 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--compact .custom-sticky-cart__btn {
    gap: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    width: 48px !important;
    height: 48px !important;

    width: 48px !important;
    height: 48px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--compact .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap {
    left: 0 !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    transform: none !important;
    width: 48px !important;
    height: 48px !important;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--animate-in {
    animation: custom-sticky-cart-slide-up 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  }
  
  .custom-sticky-cart--pending-in {
    transform: translate(-50%, 100%) !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--animate-out {
    animation: custom-sticky-cart-slide-down 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45) forwards;
  }

  @keyframes custom-sticky-cart-slide-up {
    from {
      transform: translate(-50%, 100%);
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      transform: translate(-50%, 0);
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  @keyframes custom-sticky-cart-slide-down {
    from {
      transform: translate(-50%, 0);
      opacity: 1;
    }
    to {
      transform: translate(-50%, 100%);
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.85rem;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: transparent;
    color: #fff;

    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1px;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__label {
    font-size: clamp(12px, round(nearest, calc(12px + (100vw - 360px) / 13), 2px), 14px);

    line-height: 1.1;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__count {
    font-size: clamp(12px, round(nearest, calc(12px + (100vw - 360px) / 15), 2px), 12px);

  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__images {

    height: 48px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart--expanded .custom-sticky-cart__images:has(.custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap:only-child) {
    width: 48px;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #e8f7fc;
    border: 2px solid var(--sticky-img-border);

    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }

  }

  @keyframes custom-sticky-cart-drop-in {
    from {
      transform: translateY(calc(-50% - 100px));
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap--pop-out {
    animation: custom-sticky-cart-pop-out 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45) forwards;
    z-index: 10 !important;
  }

  @keyframes custom-sticky-cart-pop-out {
    0% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1);
      opacity: 1;
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.15);
      opacity: 1;
    }
    100% {
      transform: translateY(calc(-50% - 80px)) scale(0.5);
      opacity: 0;
    }
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__gif-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    z-index: 1000;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: custom-sticky-cart-gif-fade 0.7s ease forwards;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__gif-overlay img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    display: block;
  }

  @keyframes custom-sticky-cart-gif-fade {
    0% {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(0.5);
    }
    30% {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1.2);
    }
    100% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(1.4);
    }
  }

  /* Front = most recently added; back = previous. Classes set in JS so order
     stays correct even when cart.items order differs on reconcile. */
  .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap--front {
    left: 10px;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap--back {
    left: 0;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap--front:only-child,
  .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap:only-child {

  .custom-sticky-cart__img-wrap img {

  .custom-sticky-cart__arrow {

  @media (min-width: 768px) {

  /* Sticky z-index is intentionally very high for PDP chrome; hide while
    drawers (filter, cart, menu), creator reel popup, notify-me popup,
    Judge.me write-review modal, the contextual offers sheet, or KwikPass

    Judge.me sets inline display:block on .jdgm-write-review-modal when open. */
  body:has(hdt-drawer[open]:not([closing])) .custom-sticky-cart,

  body.notify-open .custom-sticky-cart,
  body.ctx-offers-open .custom-sticky-cart,
  body.kwikpass-open .custom-sticky-cart {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }
</style>

<script>
(function() {
  // Prevent multiple initializations
  if (window.deviceIdUtilityLoaded) {
    return;
  }
  window.deviceIdUtilityLoaded = true;

  /**
   * Generates a unique device ID in UUID v4 format
   * Format: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
   * @returns {string} A unique UUID v4 string
   */
  function generateDeviceId() {
    return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, function(c) {
      const r = Math.random() * 16 | 0;
      const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);
      return v.toString(16);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Gets or creates a device ID from localStorage
   * This ID persists across sessions and is independent of user login status
   * @returns {string} The device ID
   */
  function getDeviceId() {
    const STORAGE_KEY = 'shp_device_id';
    let deviceId = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    
    // If device ID doesn't exist, generate and store it
    if (!deviceId) {
      deviceId = generateDeviceId();
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, deviceId);
        console.log('[Device ID] Generated new device ID:', deviceId);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[Device ID] Failed to store device ID in localStorage:', error);
      }
    }
    
    return deviceId;
  }

  /**
   * Resets the device ID (useful for testing or debugging)
   * Generates a new device ID and stores it
   * @returns {string} The new device ID
   */
  function resetDeviceId() {
    const STORAGE_KEY = 'shp_device_id';
    const newDeviceId = generateDeviceId();
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, newDeviceId);
      console.log('[Device ID] Reset device ID to:', newDeviceId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Device ID] Failed to reset device ID:', error);
    }
    return newDeviceId;
  }

  // Expose functions globally
  window.getDeviceId = getDeviceId;
  window.generateDeviceId = generateDeviceId;
  window.resetDeviceId = resetDeviceId;

  // Initialize device ID on load to ensure it exists
  getDeviceId();
})();
</script>

  (function () {
    var OLD_PRODUCT_ID_KEY = '_old_product_id';

    function getFormFromContext(contextEl) {
      if (!contextEl) return null;
      if (contextEl.closest) {
        var nestedForm = contextEl.closest('form');
        if (nestedForm) return nestedForm;
      }
      var formId = contextEl.getAttribute && contextEl.getAttribute('form');
      if (formId) return document.getElementById(formId);
      return null;
    }

    function getOldProductId(contextEl, productId) {
      if (contextEl) {
        var form = getFormFromContext(contextEl);
        if (form) {
          var input = form.querySelector('input[name="properties[_old_product_id]"]');
          if (input && input.value) return String(input.value);
        }

        var fromBtn = contextEl.getAttribute && contextEl.getAttribute('cardoldproductid');
        if (fromBtn) return String(fromBtn);

        var productEl = contextEl.closest
          ? contextEl.closest('[data-old-product-id]')
          : null;
        if (productEl) {
          var fromData = productEl.getAttribute('data-old-product-id');
          if (fromData) return String(fromData);
        }
      }

      if (productId && window.__oldProductIdByProductId) {
        var cached = window.__oldProductIdByProductId[String(productId)];
        if (cached) return String(cached);
      }

      return null;
    }

    function buildCartAddItem(variantId, quantity, contextEl, productId) {

        id: parseInt(variantId, 10),

      var oldProductId = getOldProductId(contextEl, productId);
      if (oldProductId) {

      return item;

    // Fetch cart data (reuses cart from variant:add / cart:change when available)
    function getcartitem(cartHint, options) {
      var forceRefresh = options && options.forceRefresh;

      if (!forceRefresh && cartHint && typeof cartHint === 'object' && Array.isArray(cartHint.items)) {
        setCartVariable(cartHint);
        return Promise.resolve(cartHint);
      }

      if (!forceRefresh && analyticsLastCart && typeof analyticsLastCart.item_count !== 'undefined') {
        setCartVariable(analyticsLastCart);
        return Promise.resolve(analyticsLastCart);
      }

      if (!window.Shopify || !window.Shopify.routes || !window.Shopify.routes.root) {
        console.error('Shopify.routes.root is not available');
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      }

      var fetchCartData =
        typeof window.createCartPromise === 'function'
          ? window.createCartPromise
          : function () {
              return fetch(window.Shopify.routes.root + 'cart.js', {
                method: 'GET',
                headers: {
                  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                }
              }).then(function (response) {
                if (!response.ok) {
                  throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
                }
                return response.json();
              });
            };

      return fetchCartData()
        .then(function (data) {
          setCartVariable(data);
          return data;
        })
        .catch(function (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching cart data:', error);
          return null;
        });

    var ME_PLATFORM = 'web';
    var lastFbqAddToCartKey = '';

    function trackME(eventName, data) {
      var payload = data || {};
      try {
        if (window.Moengage && typeof window.Moengage.track_event === 'function') {
          window.Moengage.track_event(eventName, payload);
          return;
        }
        if (window.MoEngage && typeof window.MoEngage.track_event === 'function') {
          window.MoEngage.track_event(eventName, payload);
          return;
        }
        window.Moengage = window.Moengage || [];
        window.Moengage.push(['track_event', eventName, payload]);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('MoEngage track failed:', eventName, err);
      }
    }

    function resolveOldProductId(productId, lineItem, contextEl) {
      if (lineItem && lineItem.properties && lineItem.properties._old_product_id) {
        return String(lineItem.properties._old_product_id);
      }
      if (contextEl && window.getOldProductId) {
        var fromCtx = window.getOldProductId(contextEl, productId);
        if (fromCtx) return fromCtx;
      }
      if (productId && window.__oldProductIdByProductId) {
        return window.__oldProductIdByProductId[String(productId)] || null;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function getLinePrice(lineItem) {
      if (!lineItem) return 0;
      var cents = lineItem.final_price != null ? lineItem.final_price : lineItem.price || 0;
      return cents / 100;
    }

    function mapCartLineItem(item) {
      var oldId = resolveOldProductId(item.product_id, item);
      return {
        item_id: String(item.product_id),
        product_id: oldId || String(item.product_id),
        item_name: item.product_title,
        item_variant: item.variant_id,
        quantity: item.quantity,
        price: getLinePrice(item),
        sku: item.sku
      };
    }

    function calcOrderTotal(cart) {
      if (!cart) return 0;
      return cart.total_discount > 0
        ? cart.original_total_price / 100
        : cart.total_price / 100;
    }

    function calcGrandTotal(cart, toPayOverride) {
      if (toPayOverride != null && toPayOverride !== undefined) return Number(toPayOverride);
      if (!cart) return 0;
      var shippingFeeCents =
        (window.__copyCodeCouponUi && window.__copyCodeCouponUi.shippingFeeCents) || 4000;
      var freeShippingThresholdCents =
        (window.__copyCodeCouponUi && window.__copyCodeCouponUi.freeShippingThresholdCents) || 39900;
      var originalPrice = cart.original_total_price || cart.total_price;
      if (cart.total_discount > 0) {
        return cart.total_price > freeShippingThresholdCents
          ? (originalPrice - cart.total_discount) / 100
          : ((originalPrice - cart.total_discount) + shippingFeeCents) / 100;
      }
      return cart.total_price > freeShippingThresholdCents
        ? originalPrice / 100
        : (cart.total_price + shippingFeeCents) / 100;
    }


    function productShortNameFromTitle(title) {
        if (!title) return '';

        const shortTitle = String(title)
          .replace(/^Mamaearth\.?\s*/i, '')
          .trim();

        return shortTitle.length > 25
          ? shortTitle.slice(0, 25) + '...'
          : shortTitle;
      }


    function getCouponName(cart) {
      if (!cart || !cart.cart_level_discount_applications || !cart.cart_level_discount_applications.length) {
        return null;

      return cart.cart_level_discount_applications[0].title || null;
    }

    function withFreshCart(callback, delay) {
      setTimeout(function () {

    }

    function fireAddToCartAnalytics(addedLine, cart, contextEl) {
      if (!addedLine) return;

      var shopifyProductId = addedLine.product_id;
      var oldProductId = resolveOldProductId(shopifyProductId, addedLine, contextEl);
      var purchaseAmount = getLinePrice(addedLine);
      var skuId = addedLine.sku || '';
      var productName = addedLine.product_title || addedLine.title || '';
      var quantity = addedLine.quantity || 1;
      var grandTotal = calcGrandTotal(cart);
      var orderTotal = calcOrderTotal(cart);
      var mappedItem = mapCartLineItem(addedLine);

      pushDL({
        event: 'addToCart',
        sku: skuId,
        productid: oldProductId || shopifyProductId,
        variantid: addedLine.variant_id || addedLine.id,
        cart_value_order_total: orderTotal,
        cart_value_grand_total: grandTotal,
        item_bundle: [mappedItem],
        ecommerce: {
          currencyCode: 'INR',
          add: {
            products: [{
              id: oldProductId || skuId || shopifyProductId,
              name: productName,
              price: purchaseAmount,
              sku: skuId,
              quantity: quantity,
              item_id: String(shopifyProductId),
              product_id: oldProductId || String(shopifyProductId),
              item_name: productName,
              item_variant: addedLine.variant_id || addedLine.id
            }]
          },
          userType: myUserType
        },
        currency: 'INR',
        value: grandTotal,
        add_from: page_name,
        isLoggedIn: myUserType,
        customer_id: customer_id
      });

      fireFbqAddToCart({
        content_ids: fbqProductId(oldProductId, shopifyProductId),
        content_name: productName,
        value: purchaseAmount,
        currency: (cart && cart.currency) || 'INR',
        old_product_id: oldProductId
      });

      trackME('addToCart', {
        productShortName: productShortNameFromTitle(productName),
        purchaseAmount: purchaseAmount,
        skuId: skuId,
        quantity: quantity,
        platform: ME_PLATFORM,
        productId: oldProductId || String(shopifyProductId),
        productName: productName
      });
    }

    function resolveFbqContentId(id) {
      if (id == null || id === '') return null;
      if (Array.isArray(id)) {
        id = id.find(function (v) { return v != null && v !== ''; });
        if (id == null || id === '') return null;
      }
      var idStr = String(id).trim();
      if (/^\d+$/.test(idStr)) return Number(idStr);
      return idStr;
    }

    function formatFbqContentIds(value) {
      if (value == null || value === '') return null;
      if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        var ids = value.map(resolveFbqContentId).filter(function (id) {
          return id != null && id !== '';
        });
        if (!ids.length) return null;
        if (ids.length === 1) return ids[0];
        return ids.join(',');
      }
      return resolveFbqContentId(value);
    }

    function fbqContentIdFromLineItem(item) {
      if (!item) return null;
      var oldId = resolveOldProductId(item.product_id, item);
      return resolveFbqContentId(oldId || item.product_id);
    }

    function fbqContentIdsFromLineItems(items) {
      if (!items || !items.length) return null;
      var ids = items.map(fbqContentIdFromLineItem).filter(function (id) {
        return id != null && id !== '';
      });
      return formatFbqContentIds(ids);
    }

    function fbqProductId(oldProductId, productId) {
      return resolveFbqContentId(oldProductId || productId);
    }

    function fireFbq(eventName, params, eventOptions) {
      if (typeof fbq !== 'function') return;
      if (window.__meFbqConsent) window.__meFbqConsent();

      var payload = params ? Object.assign({}, params) : {};
      if (payload.content_ids !== undefined) {
        payload.content_ids = formatFbqContentIds(payload.content_ids);
        if (payload.content_ids == null || payload.content_ids === '') return;
      }

      if (eventOptions) {
        fbq('track', eventName, payload, eventOptions);
      } else {
        fbq('track', eventName, payload);
      }
    }

    function normalizeContentIds(sku, variantId, productId) {
      var id = sku || (variantId ? String(variantId) : productId ? String(productId) : '');
      return id ? resolveFbqContentId(id) : null;
    }

    function fireFbqAddToCart(params) {
      if (typeof fbq !== 'function') return;
      if (window.__meFbqConsent) window.__meFbqConsent();

      var contentId = formatFbqContentIds(params.content_ids);
      if (contentId == null || contentId === '') return;

      var dedupeKey = String(contentId) + '|' + (params.value || 0);
      var now = Date.now();
      if (dedupeKey === lastFbqAddToCartKey && now - lastFbqAddToCartAt < 2500) return;
      lastFbqAddToCartKey = dedupeKey;
      lastFbqAddToCartAt = now;

      fireFbq('AddToCart', {
        content_ids: contentId,
        content_type: 'product',
        value: Number(params.value) || 0,
        currency: params.currency || 'INR',
        content_name: params.content_name,
        old_product_id: params.old_product_id
      });
    }

    // fireViewCart
    function fireViewCart(clickFrom) {
      withFreshCart(function (cart) {
        var items = cart.items.map(mapCartLineItem);

        var dlPayload = {

            content_type: 'product',
            value: grandTotal,

  function isAccountPath(pathname) {
    if (!pathname) return false;
    return (
      pathname === '/account' ||
      pathname.startsWith('/account/login') ||
      pathname.startsWith('/account/register') ||

   * KwikpassAccountGate
   * -------------------
   * Blocks navigation to account pages (see isAccountPath) until every required
   * KwikPass script has loaded successfully.

   * Design notes:
   * - A SINGLE delegated click listener is attached on `document` in the CAPTURE
   *   phase. This means it runs before any bubbling / inline `onclick` handlers,
   *   so navigation is reliably blocked even for links clicked before scripts
   *   finish loading (the race condition we care about). No per-anchor listeners.
   * - A MutationObserver only manages the visual `kwikpass-loading` class on
   *   dynamically injected account links; the actual click-blocking never depends
   *   on the observer, so newly added links are protected immediately by delegation.
   * - Loading state is centralized: every registered script key must flip to true

    var STYLE_ID = 'kwikpass-gate-style';

      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }

    function isAccountAnchor(anchor) {

      var href = anchor.getAttribute('href');
      // Ignore non-navigational hrefs (in-page anchors, javascript: handlers).
      if (!href || href.indexOf('javascript:') === 0 || href.charAt(0) === '#') return false;
      return isAccountPath(getAnchorPath(anchor));
    }

    // Single delegated capture-phase handler: blocks account-link navigation
    // while the gate is locked.
    function onDocumentClick(event) {
      if (unlocked) return;
      var target = event.target;
      var anchor = target && target.closest ? target.closest('a[href]') : null;
      if (!anchor || !isAccountAnchor(anchor)) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
    }

    // Add/remove the visual loading class on every current account anchor.
    function refreshAnchorClasses() {
      var anchors = document.querySelectorAll('a[href]');
      for (var i = 0; i < anchors.length; i++) {
        if (!isAccountAnchor(anchors[i])) continue;
        if (unlocked) anchors[i].classList.remove(LOADING_CLASS);
        else anchors[i].classList.add(LOADING_CLASS);

    function injectStyle() {
      if (document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)) return;
      var style = document.createElement('style');

      style.textContent = '.' + LOADING_CLASS + '{cursor:progress;opacity:.7;}';

    // Flag account links inside a freshly added DOM node.
    function flagNode(node) {
      if (node.nodeType !== 1) return; // element nodes only
      if (node.tagName === 'A' && isAccountAnchor(node)) {

      unlocked = true;
      if (clickListenerAttached) {

  function runWhenIdle(fn, timeout){
    if(typeof requestIdleCallback === 'function'){
      requestIdleCallback(fn, { timeout: timeout });
    }else{
      setTimeout(fn, 0);
    }
  }

  function isJifyScriptAlreadyPresent(){
    return !!document.querySelector('script[src*="/jify/"]');
  }

  function loadLowPriorityScript(src){
    runWhenIdle(function(){
      try{
        if(isJifyScriptAlreadyPresent()){
          return;
        }
        var script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = src;
        script.type = 'module';
        script.async = true;
        script.setAttribute('fetchpriority', 'low');
        document.body.appendChild(script);
      }catch(err){
        console.error(err);
      }
    }, 5000);
  }

  function checkMerchantStatusAndLoadLowPriorityScript(merchantId){

          headers: {
            'gk-merchant-id': merchantId,
            'kp-merchant-id': merchantId,
            'kp-request-id': kpRequestId,

        .then(function(response){ return response.json(); })
        .then(function(data){
          if(data && data.enabled === true && KP_LOW_PRIORITY_SCRIPT_URL){

// lightning sale timer 
function initLightningSaleTimers() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".st-product-card").forEach(function (card) {
    if (card.querySelector(".lightingsaletag_labels")) return;

    const fieldBox = card.querySelector(".st-extra-field-box.st_sale_end_time .st-extra-field-value");
    if (!fieldBox) return;

    const saleEndRaw = fieldBox.textContent.trim();
    if (!saleEndRaw) return;

    const saleEndTime = new Date(saleEndRaw).getTime();
    const now = Date.now();

    if (!saleEndTime || saleEndTime <= now) return;

    const imageBox =
      card.querySelector(".st-image-container") ||
      card.querySelector(".st-image-wrapper") ||
      card.querySelector(".st-outer-box");

    if (!imageBox) return;

    const timerHTML = `
      <div class="m_prod_label st-lightning-sale-wrapper">
        <div class="m_prod_labels lightening-sale">
          <div class="lightingsaletag_labels">
            <div
              class="tag lightingsale"
              data-sale-timestamp="${saleEndTime}"
              data-timer-format="colon"
            >
              <img 
                src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0721/7558/3279/files/card_lighting_sale.gif"
                width="100%"
                height="auto"
                alt="lighting sale flash"
                class="lighting_sale_flash"
              >
              <span class="lightingsaletimer"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    imageBox.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", timerHTML);
  });

  startLightningSaleCountdown();
}

function startLightningSaleCountdown() {
  document.querySelectorAll(".tag.lightingsale").forEach(function (timerBox) {
    if (timerBox.dataset.timerInitialized === "true") return;

    timerBox.dataset.timerInitialized = "true";

    const endTime = Number(timerBox.dataset.saleTimestamp);
    const timerText = timerBox.querySelector(".lightingsaletimer");

    function updateTimer() {
      const diff = endTime - Date.now();

      if (diff <= 0) {
        const wrapper = timerBox.closest(".m_prod_label");
        if (wrapper) wrapper.remove();
        return;
      }

      const totalSeconds = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
      const hours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
      const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

      timerText.textContent = `${hours}h:${minutes}m:${seconds}s`;
    }

    updateTimer();
    setInterval(updateTimer, 1000);
  });
}

document.addEventListener("stSearchResultsEvent", function () {
  setTimeout(initLightningSaleTimers, 300);
});

                "Search For Serum",
                "Search For Face Wash"
            ];

            let index = 0;
            let typingTimer;
            const updatePlaceHolder = function () {
                const phrase = placeHolderPhrases[index];
                const length = phrase.length;
                let queryIndex = 0;
                typingTimer = setInterval(function () {
                    if (queryIndex === length) {
                        setTimeout(erasePlaceHolder, 1000);

                        clearInterval(typingTimer);
                    } else {
                        const currentPlaceholderValue =
                            searchInputBox.getAttribute("placeholder");
                        searchInputBox.setAttribute(
                            "placeholder",
                            currentPlaceholderValue + phrase.charAt(queryIndex)
                        );

                        queryIndex++;
                    }
                }, 100);
            };

            const erasePlaceHolder = function () {
                const currentPlaceholderValue =
                    searchInputBox.getAttribute("placeholder");
                const length = currentPlaceholderValue.length;
                let queryIndex = length - 1;
                typingTimer = setInterval(function () {
                    if (queryIndex === -1) {
                        clearInterval(typingTimer);
                        index++;
                        if (index === placeHolderPhrases.length) {
                            index = 0;
                        }
                        setTimeout(updatePlaceHolder, 1000);
                    } else {
                        const newPlaceholderValue = currentPlaceholderValue.slice(
                            0,
                            queryIndex
                        );
                        searchInputBox.setAttribute("placeholder", newPlaceholderValue);
                        queryIndex--;
                    }
                }, 50);
            };
            updatePlaceHolder();
        }
    });
})
